Democrats shift voting habits amid Trump war on mail ballots, data finds

President Donald Trump’s unforgiving attacks on mail voting may be impacting how Democrats approach midterm voting. 

www.democracydocket.com/news-alerts/...
www.democracydocket.com/news-alerts/...

In three battleground states, data show mail ballot requests are down among Democratic voters. In North Carolina, for example, there’s been a 40% decrease in mail ballot requests since 2022, compared to a 23% decrease in requests from Republicans.

NEW: Democrats may be changing how they vote because of Trump’s nonstop mail voting attacks.

New data suggest they're requesting mail ballots at a lower rate and sending them in faster than in years past.
